narrative:
Gallia County has 18,105 registered voters, with 52.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 36.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 10.8%, a pronounced Republican lean of 25.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.9% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -16.6% D−R vs -29.5% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
